title: <Resource><Action> data
description: Registered in the Pearson Enterprise Schema Registry (Apicurio) under group: <domain>, artifact: <domain>-<resource>-<action>-data. This is the CloudEvents `data` payload only — the envelope is the shared, centrally-registered artifact referenced from asyncapi.template.yaml, never redefined here (../../../stacks/apicurio/standards/apicurio-governance.md §3).

id.description: The aggregate id this event is about — also the partition/shard key (capabilities/event/guidelines.md §1).
